      +'<div style="font-size:.62rem;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:.3rem;font-weight:500">'+fD(c.createdAt)+'</div></div>';
  })}
  h+='<div style="display:flex;gap:.4rem;margin-top:.5rem"><input id="pci-'+noteId+'" placeholder="Add a note..." style="flex:1;background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:100px;padding:.5rem 1rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text)" onkeypress="if(event.key===\'Enter\')subPCmt(\''+noteId+'\')"><button class="btn btn-grad btn-xs" onclick="subPCmt(\''+noteId+'\')">Add</button></div></div>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function subPCmt(noteId){var i=$('pci-'+noteId),t=i.value.trim();if(!t)return;i.value='';google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){ldPCmt(noteId)}).addPersonalComment(noteId,t)}

/* ── COMMUNITY ── */
function loadCommunity(){$('cFeed').innerHTML='<div class="loading"><div class="spinner"></div><br>Loading...</div>';google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(renderC).withFailureHandler(err).getCommunityPosts()}
function renderC(posts){posts=posts.filter(function(p){return!p.title||p.title.indexOf('[DEPT]')!==0});var el=$('cFeed');if(!posts||!posts.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg><h3>No ideas yet</h3><p>Be the first to share something with the team!</p></div>';return}
// Split into new (< 14 days) and ranked (>= 14 days)
var now=new Date(),TWO_WEEKS=14*24*60*60*1000;
var newPosts=[],rankedPosts=[];
posts.forEach(function(p){var age=now-new Date(p.createdAt);if(age<TWO_WEEKS)newPosts.push(p);else rankedPosts.push(p)});
// New posts: newest first (already reversed from server)
// Ranked posts: sort by votes descending, then by date if tied
rankedPosts.sort(function(a,b){var diff=(b.likes||0)-(a.likes||0);if(diff!==0)return diff;return new Date(b.createdAt)-new Date(a.createdAt)});
var h='';
// Render new posts section
if(newPosts.length){
  h+='<div style="margin-bottom:.5rem;text-align:center"><span style="font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue-l);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em">New Ideas</span></div>';
  newPosts.forEach(function(p){h+=renderOnePost(p,0,true)});
}
// Render ranked posts section
if(rankedPosts.length){
  if(newPosts.length)h+='<div style="margin:1.5rem 0 .5rem;padding-top:1rem;border-top:2px solid var(--border);text-align:center"><span style="font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em">Ranked by Team Priority</span></div>';
  rankedPosts.forEach(function(p,i){h+=renderOnePost(p,i+1,false)});
}
el.innerHTML=h}
function renderOnePost(p,rank,isNew){
  var own=p.userEmail===U.email,voted=p.likedBy&&p.likedBy.indexOf(U.email)>-1,ini=getInitials(p.userName);
  var rankHtml='';
  if(!isNew&&rank>0){
    var rc=rank<=3?'r'+rank:'rn';
    rankHtml='<span class="rank-badge '+rc+'">#'+rank+'</span>';
  }
  var newBadge=isNew?'<span class="new-badge">New</span>':'';
  var h='<div class="post" id="p-'+p.id+'" style="display:flex;gap:0">';
  h+='<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:.75rem .5rem .75rem 0;min-width:44px">';
  h+=rankHtml;
  h+='</div>';
  h+='<div style="flex:1;min-width:0">';
  h+='<div class="post-head"><div class="post-avatar"><div class="post-avatar-inner">'+ini+'</div></div><div class="post-info"><span class="pname">'+esc(p.userName||'Team Member')+(own?'<span class="post-owner-badge">You</span>':'')+'</span>'+newBadge+'<br><span class="pdate">'+fD(p.createdAt)+'</span></div></div>';
  h+='<div class="post-title">'+esc(p.title)+'</div><div class="post-body">'+renderMentions(p.content)+'</div>';
  h+='<div class="post-bar"><button class="like-btn '+(voted?'liked':'')+'" onclick="togLike(\''+p.id+'\',this)">'+svgHeart+' <span class="vote-count">'+(p.likes||0)+'</span> vote'+(p.likes!==1?'s':'')+'</button>';
  h+='<button class="comment-btn" onclick="togCmt(\''+p.id+'\')">'+svgChat+' Comments</button>';
  if(own||canDelete)h+='<div class="post-bar-right">'+(own?'<button class="btn btn-soft btn-sm" onclick="editC(\''+p.id+'\',\''+eA(p.title)+'\',\''+eA(p.content)+'\')">'+svgEdit+'</button>':'')+'<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-sm" onclick="delC(\''+p.id+'\')">'+svgTrash+'</button></div>';
  h+='</div><div class="comments" id="cm-'+p.id+'" style="display:none"></div>';
  h+='</div></div>';
  return h;
}
function addCommunity(){var t=$('cTitle').value.trim(),c=$('cContent').value.trim();if(!t){showAlert({title:'Title Required',msg:'Add a title to your post before sharing.'});return;}google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){$('cTitle').value='';$('cContent').value='';loadCommunity()}).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Post Failed',msg:e.message})}).addCommunityPost(t,c,U.email)}
function editC(id,t,c){$('eId').value=id;$('eType').value='community';$('eTitle').value=t;$('eContent').value=c;$('eModal').classList.add('show')}
function delC(id){showConfirm({title:'Delete Post',msg:'This community post will be permanently deleted.',confirmLabel:'Delete',onConfirm:function(){google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(loadCommunity).deleteCommunityPost(id)}})}
function togLike(id,btn){btn.classList.add('pop');setTimeout(function(){btn.classList.remove('pop')},450);google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){if(r){btn.querySelector('.vote-count').textContent=r.likes;var vt=r.likes!==1?' votes':' vote';btn.lastChild&&btn.lastChild.nodeType===3?(btn.lastChild.textContent=' vote'+(r.likes!==1?'s':'')):0;if(r.liked)btn.classList.add('liked');else btn.classList.remove('liked')}}).toggleLike(id)}

/* ── COMMENTS ── */
function togCmt(id){var el=$('cm-'+id);if(el.style.display==='none'){el.style.display='block';ldCmt(id)}else el.style.display='none'}
function ldCmt(id){google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(c){rCmt(id,c)}).getComments(id)}
function rCmt(id,cmts){var el=$('cm-'+id),h='';if(cmts&&cmts.length)cmts.forEach(function(c){var ci=getInitials(c.userName);h+='<div class="cmt"><div class="cmt-avatar">'+ci+'</div><div class="cmt-body"><span class="cn">'+esc(c.userName)+'</span><div class="ct">'+renderMentions(c.content)+'</div><span class="cd">'+fD(c.createdAt)+'</span></div></div>'});
h+='<div class="cmt-compose"><input id="ci-'+id+'" placeholder="Write a comment... Use @Name to tag" onkeypress="if(event.key===\'Enter\'&&!acDropdown.classList.contains(\'open\'))subCmt(\''+id+'\')"><button class="btn btn-grad btn-sm" onclick="subCmt(\''+id+'\')">Post</button></div>';el.innerHTML=h}
function subCmt(id){var i=$('ci-'+id),t=i.value.trim();if(!t)return;i.value='';google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){ldCmt(id)}).addComment(id,t,U.email)}

/* ── TRACKER ── */
var trackerItems=[],archiveItems=[],expandedRows={};
function loadTracker(){$('tBody').innerHTML='<div class="loading"><div class="spinner"></div><br>Loading...</div>';google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(items){trackerItems=items;applyFilters()}).withFailureHandler(function(e){err(e);$('tBody').innerHTML='<div class="empty"><h3>Error</h3><p>'+e.message+'</p></div>'}).getTrackerItems()}

function applyFilters(){
  var q=($('tSearch').value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),fs=$('fStatus').value,fp=$('fPriority').value,ft=$('fType')?$('fType').value:'';
  var filtered=trackerItems.filter(function(it){if(fs&&it.status!==fs)return false;if(fp&&it.priority!==fp)return false;if(ft&&(it.type||'')!==ft)return false;if(q){var hay=[it.taskName,it.description,it.notes,it.participants,it.waitingOn,it.createdByName||'',it.type||'',it.links||''].join(' ').toLowerCase();if(hay.indexOf(q)===-1)return false}return true});
  renderTable(filtered,$('tBody'),false);
}

function renderTable(items,el,isArchive){
  if(!items||!items.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6"/><path d="M12 18v-6"/><path d="M9 15h6"/></svg><h3>No initiatives found</h3><p>'+(isArchive?'Completed initiatives will appear here.':'Add your first initiative or adjust filters.')+'</p></div>';return}
  var cols,thRow;
  if(isArchive){
    cols='<col style="width:9%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:16%"><col style="width:10%"><col style="width:10%"><col style="width:10%">'+(canDelete?'<col style="width:50px">':'');
    thRow='<th>Status</th><th>Initiative</th><th>Description</th><th>Participants</th><th>Target End</th><th>Completed</th><th>Completed By</th>'+(canDelete?'<th></th>':'');
  }else{
    cols='<col style="width:9%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:28%"><col style="width:16%"><col style="width:10%"><col style="width:13%">';
    thRow='<th>Status</th><th>Initiative</th><th>Description</th><th>Participants</th><th>Target End</th><th>Actions</th>';
  }
  var h='<table><colgroup>'+cols+'</colgroup><thead><tr>'+thRow+'</tr></thead><tbody>';
  items.forEach(function(it,idx){
    var gIdx=isArchive?archiveItems.indexOf(it):trackerItems.indexOf(it);
    var isComplete=it.status==='Complete';
    // Participants
    var partNames=(it.participants||'').split(',').map(function(p){return p.trim()}).filter(Boolean);
    var partsHtml=partNames.length?partNames.map(function(p){return'<span style="white-space:nowrap;background:var(--blue-bg);color:var(--blue);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;padding:.15rem .5rem;border-radius:6px;display:inline-block;margin:.05rem">'+esc(p.split(' ')[0])+'</span>'}).join(' '):'<span style="color:var(--text-3)">—</span>';
    var typeBadge=it.type?'<span style="display:inline-block;font-size:.52rem;font-weight:700;padding:.1rem .4rem;border-radius:4px;margin-left:.35rem;vertical-align:middle;background:'+(it.type==='Tool'?'rgba(93,173,226,0.12);color:#2980B9':it.type==='Process'?'rgba(107,143,113,0.12);color:#6B8F71':it.type==='Campaign'?'rgba(245,166,35,0.12);color:#D4920A':'rgba(26,82,118,0.08);color:var(--text-3)')+'">'+esc(it.type)+'</span>':'';
    h+='<tr>';
    if(isArchive){
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip"><span class="pill s-complete"><span class="d"></span>Complete</span></td>';
    }else{
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip"><select class="inline-select" style="'+inlineStatusStyle(it.status)+'" onchange="quickUpdate(\''+it.id+'\',\'status\',this.value,this)" '+(isComplete?'disabled':'')+'>'+statusOpts(it.status)+'</select></td>';
    }
    // Initiative name — clickable to open details panel
    h+='<td><button class="init-name-link" onclick="openDetailsPanel(\''+it.id+'\','+(isArchive?'true':'false')+')">'+esc(it.taskName)+'</button>'+typeBadge+'</td>';
    // Description — full text, wrapping
    h+='<td style="overflow:visible;white-space:normal;vertical-align:top;padding-top:.7rem"><span class="tracker-slim-desc">'+esc(it.description||'—')+'</span></td>';
    // Participants
    h+='<td class="td-no-clip tracker-slim-parts">'+partsHtml+'</td>';
    if(isArchive){
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip">'+fD(it.anticipatedEndDate)+'</td>';
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip">'+fD(it.archivedAt||it.actualEndDate)+'</td>';
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip"><span class="creator-badge">'+esc(it.completedByName||'—')+'</span></td>';
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip" style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs" onclick="openDetailsPanel(\''+it.id+'\',true)" title="View Details"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 16v-4M12 8h.01"/></svg></button>'+(canDelete?' <button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-xs" onclick="confirmArchiveDelete(\''+it.id+'\',\''+eA(it.taskName)+'\')" title="Delete">'+svgTrash+'</button>':'')+'</td>';
    }else{
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip">'+fD(it.anticipatedEndDate)+'</td>';
      h+='<td class="td-no-clip" style="white-space:nowrap">';
      h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs" onclick="openDetailsPanel(\''+it.id+'\',false)" title="View Details"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 16v-4M12 8h.01"/></svg></button> ';
      if(!isComplete){
        if(it.approvalStatus==='approved'){
          h+='<button class="btn btn-green btn-xs" onclick="showCompleteModal('+gIdx+')" title="Complete">'+svgCheck+'</button> ';
        } else if(it.approvalStatus==='pending'){
          h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs" disabled style="opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none" title="Pending Approval"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 6v6l4 2"/></svg></button> ';
        } else {
          h+='<button class="btn btn-green btn-xs" onclick="showApproveModal('+gIdx+')" title="Request Approval">'+svgCheck+'</button> ';
        }
      }
      h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs" onclick="editTByIdx('+gIdx+')" title="Edit">'+svgEdit+'</button> ';
      if(canDelete)h+='<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-xs" onclick="delT(\''+it.id+'\')" title="Delete">'+svgTrash+'</button>';
      h+='</td>';
    }
    h+='</tr>';
  });
  h+='</tbody></table>';el.innerHTML=h;
}

function statusOpts(cur){return['Not Started','In Progress','On Hold','Awaiting Approval','Approved','Complete','Other (See Notes)'].map(function(o){return'<option'+(o===cur?' selected':'')+'>'+o+'</option>'}).join('')}
function priorityOpts(cur){return['Low','Medium','High'].map(function(o){return'<option'+(o===cur?' selected':'')+'>'+o+'</option>'}).join('')}
function inlineStatusStyle(s){if(s==='Not Started')return'color:#5DADE2;';if(s==='In Progress')return'color:#2980B9;';if(s==='On Hold')return'color:#1A5276;';if(s==='Complete')return'color:#6B8F71;';if(s==='Awaiting Approval')return'color:#D4920A;font-weight:700';if(s==='Approved')return'color:#4A7C54;font-weight:700';return'color:#82A888;'}
function inlinePriorityStyle(p){return p==='High'?'color:#1A5276;':p==='Medium'?'color:#2980B9;':'color:#82A888;'}
function sC(s){if(s==='In Progress')return's-active';if(s==='On Hold')return's-pending';if(s==='Complete')return's-complete';if(s==='Not Started')return's-planning';if(s==='Awaiting Approval')return's-await';if(s==='Approved')return's-approved';return's-other'}
function pC(p){return p==='High'?'p-high':p==='Medium'?'p-med':'p-low'}

function quickUpdate(id,field,value,sel){
  if(field==='status'&&value==='Complete'){var idx=trackerItems.findIndex(function(it){return it.id===id});if(idx>-1){sel.value=trackerItems[idx].status;showCompleteModal(idx);return}}
  if(field==='status'&&(value==='Awaiting Approval'||value==='Approved')){var _it=trackerItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id});if(_it)sel.value=_it.status;return}
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){var it=trackerItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id});if(it)it[field]=value;if(field==='status')sel.setAttribute('style',inlineStatusStyle(value));if(field==='priority')sel.setAttribute('style',inlinePriorityStyle(value))}).withFailureHandler(err).quickUpdateField(id,field,value);
}

function quickWaitUpdate(id,value,sel){
  var notify=!!value;
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
    var it=trackerItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id});
    if(it){it.waitingOn=value;it.waitingOnSetAt=value?new Date().toISOString():''}
    sel.className='inline-wait-select'+(value?'':' none');
    if(notify)sel.title='Notification sent to '+value;
  }).withFailureHandler(err).updateWaitingOn(id,value,notify);
}

/* ── ARCHIVE ── */
function loadArchive(){$('aBody').innerHTML='<div class="loading"><div class="spinner"></div><br>Loading...</div>';google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(items){archiveItems=items;applyArchiveFilters()}).withFailureHandler(function(e){err(e);$('aBody').innerHTML='<div class="empty"><h3>Error</h3><p>'+e.message+'</p></div>'}).getArchiveItems()}
function applyArchiveFilters(){
  var q=($('aSearch').value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),fp=$('aFPriority').value;
  var filtered=archiveItems.filter(function(it){if(fp&&it.priority!==fp)return false;if(q){var hay=(it.taskName+' '+it.description+' '+it.completedByName+' '+it.createdByName+' '+it.participants).toLowerCase();if(hay.indexOf(q)===-1)return false}return true});
  renderTable(filtered,$('aBody'),true);
}

/* ── DETAILS PANEL ── */
var dpCurrentId=null,dpIsArchive=false,dpCurrentNotes=[];

function openDetailsPanel(id,isArchive){
  dpCurrentId=id;dpIsArchive=isArchive;
  var it=(isArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===id});
  if(!it)return;
  $('dpCrumbName').textContent=it.taskName||'Initiative';
  // Build action buttons
  // Build action buttons — show Approve or Complete depending on approvalStatus
  var btnH='';
  if(!isArchive){
    if(it.status!=='Complete'){
      if(it.approvalStatus==='approved'){
        btnH+='<button class="btn btn-green btn-sm" onclick="dpCompleteById(\''+it.id+'\')">'+ svgCheck+' Complete</button>';
      } else if(it.approvalStatus==='pending'){
        btnH+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled style="opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v4M12 16h.01"/></svg> Pending</button>';
      } else {
        btnH+='<button class="btn btn-green btn-sm" onclick="dpApproveById(\''+it.id+'\')">'+ svgCheck+' Approve</button>';
      }
    }
    btnH+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-sm" onclick="dpEditById(\''+it.id+'\')">'+ svgEdit+' Edit</button>';
    if(canDelete)btnH+='<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-sm" onclick="delT(\''+it.id+'\')">'+ svgTrash+'</button>';
  }
  $('dpActionBtns').innerHTML=btnH;
  $('dpBody').innerHTML='<div class="loading"><div class="spinner"></div><br>Loading details...</div>';
  $('detailsPanel').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  // Load updates then render
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(bundle){renderDetailsPanel(it,bundle.updates||[],isArchive,bundle.notes||[])}).withFailureHandler(function(){renderDetailsPanel(it,[],isArchive,[])}).getInitiativeDetailsBundle(id);
}

function closeDetailsPanel(){
  $('detailsPanel').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
  dpCurrentId=null;
}
function dpCompleteById(id){
  var list=dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems;
  var idx=list.findIndex(function(i){return i.id===id});
  if(idx>-1)showCompleteModal(idx);
}
function dpEditById(id){
  var list=dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems;
  var it=list.find(function(i){return i.id===id});
  if(it)editT(it);
}
function editDpNotes(id,currentNotes){
  $('enId').value=id;
  $('enNotes').value=currentNotes;
  $('editNotesModal').classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(function(){var el=$('enNotes');el.focus();autoGrow(el)},100);
}
function closeEditNotesModal(){$('editNotesModal').classList.remove('show')}
function submitEditNotes(){
  var id=$('enId').value,notes=$('enNotes').value.trim();
  closeEditNotesModal();
  var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===id});
  if(!it)return;
  var updated=Object.assign({},it,{notes:notes});
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
    loadTracker();
    setTimeout(function(){openDetailsPanel(id,dpIsArchive)},600);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).updateTrackerItem(updated);
}
function deleteDpNotes(id){
  showConfirm({title:'Remove Notes',msg:'This will clear the notes from this initiative.',confirmLabel:'Remove',onConfirm:function(){
  var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===id});
  if(!it)return;
  var updated=Object.assign({},it,{notes:''});
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
    loadTracker();
    setTimeout(function(){openDetailsPanel(id,dpIsArchive)},600);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).updateTrackerItem(updated);

  }});
}

// ESC key closes panel
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.key==='Escape'&&$('detailsPanel').classList.contains('open')&&!document.querySelector('.overlay.show'))closeDetailsPanel();
});

function renderDetailsPanel(it,updates,isArchive,notes){
  dpCurrentNotes=notes||[];
  var creatorDisplay=it.createdByName||'';
  if(!creatorDisplay&&it.createdBy&&it.createdBy!=='anonymous'){creatorDisplay=it.createdBy.split('@')[0].replace(/[._]/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g,function(l){return l.toUpperCase()})}
  var isComp=it.status==='Complete';
  var partNames=(it.participants||'').split(',').map(function(p){return p.trim()}).filter(Boolean);
  var waitNames=(it.waitingOn||'').split(',').map(function(n){return n.trim()}).filter(Boolean);

  // ── STATUS STYLE ──
  var statusStyle=inlineStatusStyle(it.status);

  // ── HERO CARD ──
  var h='<div class="dp-hero">';
  // Logo / brand box
  h+='<div class="dp-logo-box">';
  h+='<div class="dp-logo-icon" style="background:transparent;border:none;"><img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:contain;display:block;" alt="Single Throw"></div>';
  h+='<div>';
  h+='<div class="dp-logo-label" style="margin-bottom:.5rem">Single Throw</div>';
  if(it.type)h+='<div class="dp-type-badge">'+esc(it.type)+'</div>';
  h+='</div></div>';
  // Info panel
  h+='<div class="dp-info">';
  h+='<div class="dp-info-title">'+esc(it.taskName)+'</div>';
  h+='<div class="dp-info-meta">';
  h+='<span class="pill '+sC(it.status)+'"><span class="d"></span>'+esc(it.status)+'</span>';
  if(it.priority)h+='<span class="'+pC(it.priority)+'" style="font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700">'+esc(it.priority)+' Priority</span>';
  if(creatorDisplay)h+='<span style="font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-3);font-weight:600">by '+esc(creatorDisplay)+'</span>';
  if(it.createdAt)h+='<span style="font-size:.68rem;color:var(--text-3)">Created '+fD(it.createdAt)+'</span>';
  h+='</div>';
  // Spec grid
  h+='<div class="dp-spec-grid">';
  h+='<div class="dp-spec"><div class="dp-spec-label">Start Date</div><div class="dp-spec-value">'+(it.startDate?fD(it.startDate):'Not set')+'</div></div>';
  h+='<div class="dp-spec"><div class="dp-spec-label">Target End</div><div class="dp-spec-value'+((!isComp&&it.anticipatedEndDate&&new Date(it.anticipatedEndDate)<new Date())?' overdue':'')+'">'+( it.anticipatedEndDate?fD(it.anticipatedEndDate):'Not set')+'</div></div>';
  if(isComp&&it.actualEndDate)h+='<div class="dp-spec"><div class="dp-spec-label">Completed</div><div class="dp-spec-value" style="color:var(--green)">'+fD(it.actualEndDate)+'</div></div>';
  if(partNames.length){
    h+='<div class="dp-spec" style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="dp-spec-label">Participants</div><div class="dp-participants" style="margin-top:.3rem">';
    partNames.forEach(function(p){var ini=getInitials(p);h+='<div class="dp-part-chip"><div class="dp-part-avatar">'+ini+'</div>'+esc(p)+'</div>'});
    h+='</div></div>';
  }
  h+='</div>';
  h+='</div>';
  h+='</div>'; // /dp-hero

  // ── APPROVAL BANNER ──
  if(!isArchive&&it.approvalStatus==='approved'){
    h+='<div style="margin:0 1.75rem 1.25rem;background:rgba(107,143,113,0.1);border:1.5px solid var(--green-l);border-radius:12px;padding:.9rem 1.25rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem">';
    h+='<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--green)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>';
    h+='<div><div style="font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:.15rem">Approved for Completion</div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:.76rem;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.5">This initiative has been approved for completion. Click <strong>Complete</strong> to finalize it.</div></div>';
    h+='</div>';
  } else if(!isArchive&&it.approvalStatus==='denied'){
    h+='<div style="margin:0 1.75rem 1.25rem;background:rgba(217,79,79,0.07);border:1.5px solid rgba(217,79,79,0.35);border-radius:12px;padding:.9rem 1.25rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem">';
    h+='<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--danger)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M15 9l-6 6M9 9l6 6"/></svg>';
    h+='<div><div style="font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--danger);margin-bottom:.15rem">Completion Denied</div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:.76rem;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.5">This completion request was denied. Review the feedback sent to participants, make the necessary changes, then re-submit for approval.</div></div>';
    h+='</div>';
  } else if(!isArchive&&it.approvalStatus==='pending'){
    h+='<div style="margin:0 1.75rem 1.25rem;background:rgba(245,166,35,0.08);border:1.5px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.4);border-radius:12px;padding:.9rem 1.25rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem">';
    h+='<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#D4920A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 6v6l4 2"/></svg>';
    h+='<div><div style="font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;color:#D4920A;margin-bottom:.15rem">Awaiting Approval</div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:.76rem;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.5">An approval request has been sent. You\'ll be notified once a decision is made.</div></div>';
    h+='</div>';
  }

  // ── DESCRIPTION ──
  if(it.description){
    h+='<div class="dp-desc-block"><h4><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6"/><path d="M16 13H8M16 17H8M10 9H8"/></svg> Description</h4>';
    h+='<p>'+esc(it.description)+'</p></div>';
  }

  // ── TIMELINE + UPDATES SECTION ──
  h+='<div class="dp-timeline-updates">';
  h+='<div class="dp-section-head"><h4><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 6v6l4 2"/></svg> Timeline &amp; Updates</h4>';
  h+='</div>';

  // Waiting on banner
  if(waitNames.length){
    h+='<div class="dp-waiting-banner"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v4l3 3"/></svg><span>Waiting on: <strong>'+waitNames.map(function(n){return esc(n)}).join(', ')+'</strong></span></div>';
  }

  // ── NOTES STREAM ──
  h+='<div class="dp-notes-stream" id="dp-notes-block-'+it.id+'">';
  h+='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.75rem">';
  h+='<div class="dp-notes-label">Notes</div>';
  h+='</div>';
  // Render existing notes (passed in as dpCurrentNotes)
  if(dpCurrentNotes&&dpCurrentNotes.length){
    dpCurrentNotes.forEach(function(n){
      h+='<div class="dp-note-entry" id="dpne-'+n.id+'">';
      h+='<div class="dp-note-content" id="dpnc-'+n.id+'">'+esc(n.content)+'</div>';
      h+='<div class="dp-note-meta"><span class="dp-note-author">'+esc(n.userName)+'</span><span class="dp-note-date">'+fD(n.createdAt)+'</span>';
      if(!isArchive){
        h+='<div class="dp-note-actions">';
        h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs dp-note-edit" onclick="editDpNote(\''+n.id+'\',\''+it.id+'\')">'+svgEdit+'</button>';
        h+='<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-xs dp-note-del" onclick="deleteDpNote(\''+n.id+'\',\''+it.id+'\')">'+svgTrash+'</button>';
        h+='</div>';
      }
      h+='</div></div>';
    });
  } else {
    h+='<div class="dp-note-empty">No notes yet. Add the first one below.</div>';
  }
  // Add note form (non-archive only)
  if(!isArchive){
    h+='<div class="dp-note-add-row">';
    h+='<textarea id="dpNoteInput-'+it.id+'" class="dp-note-textarea" placeholder="Add a note..." rows="2" oninput="autoGrow(this)"></textarea>';
    h+='<button class="btn btn-grad btn-sm" onclick="submitDpNote(\''+it.id+'\')"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg> Add Note</button>';
    h+='</div>';
  }
  h+='</div>';

  // ── LINKS SECTION ──
  h+='<div class="dp-links-section" id="dp-links-block-'+it.id+'">';
  h+='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.6rem">';
  h+='<div class="dp-notes-label"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"/><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"/></svg> Links</div>';
  h+='</div>';
  if(it.links){
    var la=it.links.split(',').map(function(l){return l.trim()}).filter(Boolean);
    if(la.length){
      la.forEach(function(l,li){
        var parsed=parseLinkEntry(l);
        h+='<div class="dp-link-row">';
        if(parsed.title)h+='<span class="dp-link-title">'+esc(parsed.title)+'</span>';
        h+='<a href="'+esc(parsed.url)+'" target="_blank" class="link-chip" style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">'+svgLink+' '+esc(parsed.display)+'</a>';
        if(!isArchive){
          h+='<div style="display:flex;gap:.25rem;flex-shrink:0">';
          h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs" onclick="editDpLink(\''+it.id+'\','+li+',\''+eA(l)+'\')">'+svgEdit+'</button>';
          h+='<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-xs" onclick="deleteDpLink(\''+it.id+'\','+li+')">'+svgTrash+'</button>';
          h+='</div>';
        }
        h+='</div>';
      });
    } else {
      h+='<div class="dp-note-empty">No links added.</div>';
    }
  } else {
    h+='<div class="dp-note-empty">No links added.</div>';
  }
  if(!isArchive){
    h+='<div class="dp-link-add-row" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr auto;gap:.5rem;margin-top:.6rem;align-items:center">';
    h+='<input id="dpLinkTitle-'+it.id+'" placeholder="Title (e.g. SOP Doc)" style="background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .75rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text)">';
    h+='<input id="dpLinkInput-'+it.id+'" placeholder="Paste a URL..." style="background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .75rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text)" onkeypress="if(event.key===\'Enter\')addDpLink(\''+it.id+'\')">';
    h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-sm" onclick="addDpLink(\''+it.id+'\')"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg> Add</button>';
    h+='</div>';
  }
  h+='</div>';

  // Completion info
  if(isComp&&(it.completionDesc||it.sopLink)){
    h+='<div class="dp-completion-block" style="margin:0 1.75rem 1.25rem;background:rgba(107,143,113,0.06);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;border-left:3px solid var(--green)">';
    h+='<div style="font-size:.55rem;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:.6rem">✓ Completion Details</div>';
    if(it.completedByName)h+='<div style="font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-2);margin-bottom:.4rem"><strong>Completed by:</strong> '+esc(it.completedByName)+'</div>';
    if(it.completionDesc)h+='<div style="font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:.6rem">'+esc(it.completionDesc)+'</div>';
    if(it.sopLink)h+='<a href="'+esc(it.sopLink)+'" target="_blank" class="link-chip" style="font-size:.72rem">'+svgLink+' SOP / Documentation</a>';
    h+='</div>';
  }

  // ── TIMELINE PROGRESS BAR ──
  var startD=it.startDate?new Date(it.startDate):null;
  var endD=it.anticipatedEndDate?new Date(it.anticipatedEndDate):null;
  var now=new Date();var pct=0,daysLeft=0,totalDays=0,isOverdue=false;
  if(startD&&endD){totalDays=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((endD-startD)/86400000));var elapsed=Math.ceil((now-startD)/86400000);daysLeft=Math.ceil((endD-now)/86400000);if(isComp)pct=100;else{pct=Math.min(100,Math.max(0,Math.round((elapsed/totalDays)*100)));isOverdue=daysLeft<0}}else if(isComp)pct=100;

  h+='<div class="timeline-panel" style="margin:0;border-radius:0;border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--border)">';
  h+='<div class="timeline-header"><h5><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 6v6l4 2"/></svg> Progress</h5>';
  h+='<div class="timeline-dates">';
  h+='<div class="timeline-date"><span class="td-label">Start</span><span class="td-value">'+(it.startDate?fD(it.startDate):'Not set')+'</span></div>';
  h+='<div class="timeline-date"><span class="td-label">Target End</span><span class="td-value'+(isOverdue?' overdue':'')+'">'+( it.anticipatedEndDate?fD(it.anticipatedEndDate):'Not set')+'</span></div>';
  if(isComp&&it.actualEndDate)h+='<div class="timeline-date"><span class="td-label">Completed</span><span class="td-value" style="color:var(--green)">'+fD(it.actualEndDate)+'</span></div>';
  h+='</div></div>';
  h+='<div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill'+(isComp?' complete':(isOverdue?' overdue':''))+'" style="width:'+pct+'%"></div></div>';
  h+='<div class="progress-stats">';
  if(isComp){h+='<span class="ps-pct" style="color:var(--green)">✓ Complete</span>';if(it.actualEndDate&&it.anticipatedEndDate){var diff=Math.ceil((new Date(it.actualEndDate)-new Date(it.anticipatedEndDate))/86400000);if(diff>0)h+='<span style="color:var(--danger)">'+diff+'d late</span>';else if(diff<0)h+='<span style="color:var(--green)">'+Math.abs(diff)+'d early</span>';else h+='<span>On time</span>'}}
  else if(startD&&endD){h+='<span class="ps-pct'+(isOverdue?' overdue':'')+'">'+pct+'% elapsed</span>';if(isOverdue)h+='<span style="color:var(--danger);font-weight:700">'+Math.abs(daysLeft)+'d overdue</span>';else h+='<span>'+daysLeft+'d remaining ('+totalDays+' total)</span>'}
  else{h+='<span>Set start &amp; target dates for tracking</span>'}
  h+='</div></div>';

  // ── UPDATES TABLE ──
  h+='<div style="padding:1.25rem 1.75rem">';
  h+='<h4 style="font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem">'+svgUpdate+' Milestones</h4>';

  // Add-update form (always at top for non-archive)
  if(!isArchive&&!isComp){
    h+='<div id="dp-add-update-form-'+it.id+'" style="background:var(--bg);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;margin-bottom:1rem;border:1.5px dashed var(--border)" id="dpAddUpd">';
    h+='<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:.6rem;margin-bottom:.6rem">';
    h+='<div style="grid-column:1/-1"><textarea id="dpUcDesc-'+it.id+'" class="auto-grow" placeholder="Describe the update, action item, or progress note..." rows="2" style="width:100%;background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.55rem .75rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text);resize:vertical" oninput="autoGrow(this)"></textarea></div>';
    h+='<div><label style="font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;display:block;margin-bottom:.25rem">Assigned To</label><select id="dpUcAssign-'+it.id+'" style="width:100%;background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .6rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text)"><option value="">None</option>';
    TEAM_LIST.forEach(function(t){h+='<option value="'+t.name+'">'+t.name+'</option>'});
    h+='</select></div>';
    h+='<div><label style="font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;display:block;margin-bottom:.25rem">Waiting On</label><select id="dpUcWait-'+it.id+'" style="width:100%;background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .6rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text)"><option value="">None</option>';
    TEAM_LIST.forEach(function(t){h+='<option value="'+t.name+'">'+t.name+'</option>'});
    h+='</select></div>';
    h+='<div><label style="font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;display:block;margin-bottom:.25rem">Target Date</label><input type="date" id="dpUcTarget-'+it.id+'" style="width:100%;background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .6rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text)"></div>';
    h+='</div>';
    h+='<div style="display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:center"><input id="dpUcLinks-'+it.id+'" placeholder="Links (optional, comma-separated)" style="flex:1;background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .6rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text)"><button class="btn btn-grad btn-sm" onclick="addUpdateFromPanelSubmit(\''+it.id+'\')"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg> Add</button></div>';
    h+='</div>';
  }

  // Render updates
  var activeUpdates=[],doneUpdates=[];
  if(updates&&updates.length){
    updates.forEach(function(u){if(u.completed==='YES')doneUpdates.push(u);else activeUpdates.push(u)});
    activeUpdates.sort(function(a,b){return new Date(b.createdAt)-new Date(a.createdAt)});
    doneUpdates.sort(function(a,b){return new Date(b.createdAt)-new Date(a.createdAt)});
  }

  h+='<div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="update-table" style="margin-top:.25rem;min-width:875px;table-layout:fixed">';
  h+='<colgroup><col style="width:120px"><col style="width:180px"><col style="width:110px"><col style="width:110px"><col style="width:95px"><col style="width:75px"><col style="width:55px"><col style="width:55px"><col style="width:75px"></colgroup>';
  h+='<thead><tr><th>By</th><th>Update</th><th>Assigned To</th><th>Waiting On</th><th>Target Date</th><th>Days Left</th><th style="text-align:center">Done</th><th>Links</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>';

  var renderDpUpdateRow=function(u,isDone){
    var ini=getInitials(u.userName);
    var rowStyle=isDone?' style="opacity:.65"':'';
    var daysHtml='—';
    if(u.targetDate){
      var td=new Date(u.targetDate),tNow=new Date();
      td.setHours(0,0,0,0);tNow.setHours(0,0,0,0);
      var dl=Math.ceil((td-tNow)/86400000);
      if(isDone){daysHtml='<span class="days-badge days-done">✓</span>'}
      else if(dl<0){daysHtml='<span class="days-badge days-over">'+Math.abs(dl)+'d over</span>'}
      else if(dl<=3){daysHtml='<span class="days-badge days-warn">'+dl+'d</span>'}
      else{daysHtml='<span class="days-badge days-ok">'+dl+'d</span>'}
    }
    var targetHtml='—';
    if(u.targetDate){var tOver=new Date(u.targetDate)<new Date();targetHtml='<span class="ut-target '+(tOver&&!isDone?'overdue':'ok')+'">'+fD(u.targetDate)+'</span>'}
    h+='<tr'+rowStyle+'>';
    h+='<td style="white-space:nowrap"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem"><div class="update-avatar" style="width:24px;height:24px;font-size:.5rem">'+ini+'</div><div><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:.72rem">'+esc(u.userName)+'</div><div class="ut-meta">'+fD(u.createdAt)+'</div></div></div></td>';
    h+='<td><div class="ut-desc">'+renderMentions(u.description)+'</div>';
    h+='<button class="ut-cmt-toggle" onclick="togUCmt(\''+u.id+'\',\''+it.id+'\')">Comments</button>';
    h+='<div id="ucmt-'+u.id+'" style="display:none"></div></td>';
    h+='<td style="max-width:130px"><select class="inline-select" style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--blue);width:100%;max-width:130px" onchange="updField(\''+u.id+'\',\'assignedTo\',this.value)"><option value="">—</option>';
    TEAM_LIST.forEach(function(t){h+='<option'+(u.assignedTo===t.name?' selected':'')+'>'+t.name+'</option>'});
    h+='</select></td>';
    h+='<td style="max-width:130px"><select class="inline-select" style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--blue);width:100%;max-width:130px" onchange="updField(\''+u.id+'\',\'waitingOn\',this.value)"><option value="">—</option>';
    TEAM_LIST.forEach(function(t){h+='<option'+(u.waitingOn===t.name?' selected':'')+'>'+t.name+'</option>'});
    h+='</select></td>';
    h+='<td style="white-space:nowrap">'+targetHtml+'</td>';
    h+='<td style="white-space:nowrap">'+daysHtml+'</td>';
    h+='<td style="text-align:center"><input type="checkbox" '+(isDone?'checked':'')+' onchange="togUpdateDonePanel(\''+u.id+'\',\''+it.id+'\',this.checked)" style="width:16px;height:16px;cursor:pointer;accent-color:var(--green)"></td>';
    h+='<td>';
    if(u.links){u.links.split(',').forEach(function(l){l=l.trim();if(l){var ld=l.replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?/,'').substring(0,35);h+='<a href="'+esc(l)+'" target="_blank" class="link-chip">'+svgLink+' '+esc(ld)+'</a> '}})}
    h+='</td>';
    h+='<td style="white-space:nowrap">';
    h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs" onclick="editUpdatePanel(\''+u.id+'\',\''+it.id+'\',\''+eA(u.description)+'\')">'+svgEdit+'</button> ';
    h+='<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-xs" onclick="delUpdatePanel(\''+u.id+'\',\''+it.id+'\')">'+svgTrash+'</button>';
    h+='</td></tr>';
  };

  if(activeUpdates.length){activeUpdates.forEach(function(u){renderDpUpdateRow(u,false)})}
  else if(!doneUpdates.length){h+='<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-3);font-size:.82rem">No updates yet. Add the first one above.</td></tr>'}
  if(doneUpdates.length){
    h+='<tr><td colspan="9" style="padding:.4rem .6rem;background:var(--bg);border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><span style="font-size:.6rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em">✓ Completed</span></td></tr>';
    doneUpdates.forEach(function(u){renderDpUpdateRow(u,true)});
  }
  h+='</tbody></table></div></div></div>';

  $('dpBody').innerHTML=h;
}

function addUpdateFromPanelSubmit(initId){
  var d=$('dpUcDesc-'+initId).value.trim(),a=$('dpUcAssign-'+initId)?$('dpUcAssign-'+initId).value:'',l=$('dpUcLinks-'+initId).value.trim(),w=$('dpUcWait-'+initId)?$('dpUcWait-'+initId).value:'',td=$('dpUcTarget-'+initId)?$('dpUcTarget-'+initId).value:'';
  if(!d){showAlert({title:'Update Required',msg:'Please describe the update before saving.'});return;}
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
    var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===initId});
    if(it)google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(b){renderDetailsPanel(it,b.updates||[],dpIsArchive,b.notes||[])}).getInitiativeDetailsBundle(initId);
  }).addUpdate(initId,d,a,l,w,td,'');
}
function addUpdateFromPanel(initId){
  // Scroll to the add update form
  var el=$('dpUcDesc-'+initId);
  if(el){el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});el.focus()}
}
function togUpdateDonePanel(uid,iid,checked){
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
    var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===iid});
    if(it&&r&&r.updates)google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(b){renderDetailsPanel(it,b.updates||[],dpIsArchive,b.notes||[])}).getInitiativeDetailsBundle(iid);
    else if(it)google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(b){renderDetailsPanel(it,b.updates||[],dpIsArchive,b.notes||[])}).getInitiativeDetailsBundle(iid);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).toggleUpdateCompleted(uid,checked);
}
function delUpdatePanel(uid,iid){
  showConfirm({title:'Delete Update',msg:'This update will be permanently removed.',confirmLabel:'Delete',onConfirm:function(){
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
      var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===iid});
      if(it)google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(b){renderDetailsPanel(it,b.updates||[],dpIsArchive,b.notes||[])}).getInitiativeDetailsBundle(iid);
    }).deleteUpdate(uid);
  }});
}
function editUpdatePanel(uid,iid,currentDesc){
  $('euUid').value=uid;
  $('euIid').value=iid;
  $('euDesc').value=currentDesc;
  $('editUpdateModal').classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(function(){$('euDesc').focus();autoGrow($('euDesc'))},100);
}
function closeEditUpdateModal(){$('editUpdateModal').classList.remove('show')}
function submitEditUpdate(){
  var uid=$('euUid').value,iid=$('euIid').value,desc=$('euDesc').value.trim();
  if(!desc)return;
  closeEditUpdateModal();
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
    var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===iid});
    if(it&&r&&r.updates)google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(b){renderDetailsPanel(it,b.updates||[],dpIsArchive,b.notes||[])}).getInitiativeDetailsBundle(iid);
    else if(it)google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(b){renderDetailsPanel(it,b.updates||[],dpIsArchive,b.notes||[])}).getInitiativeDetailsBundle(iid);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).editUpdate(uid,desc);
}

/* ── LEGACY EXPAND (kept for any residual references, now no-ops) ── */
var expandedRows={};
function toggleExpand(){}
function loadUpdates(id){
  var it=trackerItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id})||archiveItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id});
  var el=$('upd-'+id);if(!el)return;
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(u){renderUpdates(id,u)}).withFailureHandler(err).getUpdates(id);
}
function renderUpdates(id,updates){
  var el=$('upd-'+id);if(!el)return;
  var it=trackerItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id})||archiveItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id});
  var h='<p style="font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-3);padding:.5rem">Use the details panel (click the initiative name) to manage updates.</p>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
// ── UPDATE COMMENTS (sub-comments on each update row) ──
function togUCmt(updateId,initId){var el=$('ucmt-'+updateId);if(!el)return;if(el.style.display==='none'){el.style.display='block';ldUCmt(updateId)}else el.style.display='none'}
function ldUCmt(updateId){google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(c){rUCmt(updateId,c)}).withFailureHandler(err).getUpdateComments(updateId)}
function rUCmt(updateId,cmts){
  var el=$('ucmt-'+updateId);if(!el)return;
  var h='<div class="ut-comments">';
  if(cmts&&cmts.length)cmts.forEach(function(c){var ci=getInitials(c.userName);h+='<div class="ut-cmt"><div class="ut-cmt-avatar">'+ci+'</div><div class="ut-cmt-body"><span class="ut-cn">'+esc(c.userName)+'</span> <span class="ut-cd">'+fD(c.createdAt)+'</span><div class="ut-ct">'+renderMentions(c.content)+'</div></div></div>'});
  h+='<div class="ut-cmt-compose"><input id="uci-'+updateId+'" placeholder="Reply..." onkeypress="if(event.key===\'Enter\')subUCmt(\''+updateId+'\')"><button class="btn btn-grad btn-xs" onclick="subUCmt(\''+updateId+'\')">Reply</button></div></div>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function subUCmt(updateId){
  var i=$('uci-'+updateId),t=i.value.trim();
  if(!t)return;
  i.value='';i.disabled=true;
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(c){
    i.disabled=false;
    // Append new comment directly without reloading all comments
    if(c&&c.id){
      var el=$('ucmt-'+updateId);
      if(el){
        var existing=el.querySelector('.ut-comments');
        if(!existing){ldUCmt(updateId);return;}
        var compose=existing.querySelector('.ut-cmt-compose');
        var div=document.createElement('div');
        div.className='ut-cmt';
        div.innerHTML='<div class="ut-cmt-avatar">'+getInitials(c.userName)+'</div><div class="ut-cmt-body"><span class="ut-cn">'+esc(c.userName)+'</span> <span class="ut-cd">'+fD(c.createdAt)+'</span><div class="ut-ct">'+renderMentions(c.content)+'</div></div>';
        existing.insertBefore(div,compose);
      }
    } else {ldUCmt(updateId);}
  }).withFailureHandler(function(){i.disabled=false;}).addUpdateComment(updateId,t);
}

function addUpdateFn(initId){var d=$('ucDesc-'+initId).value.trim(),a=$('ucAssign-'+initId)?$('ucAssign-'+initId).value:'',l=$('ucLinks-'+initId).value.trim(),w=$('ucWait-'+initId)?$('ucWait-'+initId).value:'',td=$('ucTarget-'+initId)?$('ucTarget-'+initId).value:'';if(!d){showAlert({title:'Update Required',msg:'Please describe the update before saving.'});return;}google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){loadUpdates(initId)}).addUpdate(initId,d,a,l,w,td,'')}

function togUpdateDone(uid,iid,checked){google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){if(checked)loadUpdates(iid)}).withFailureHandler(err).toggleUpdateCompleted(uid,checked)}
function updField(uid,field,value){google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){}).withFailureHandler(err).updateUpdateField(uid,field,value)}

// Auto-grow textarea
function autoGrow(el){el.style.height='auto';el.style.height=el.scrollHeight+'px'}

// Participant management for existing update rows
var newRowParts={};
function toggleUtPartDrop(uid){var d=$('utpd-'+uid);if(d)d.classList.toggle('open')}
function addUtPart(uid,name){
  // Add participant to existing update
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
    // Find the initiative id from the update's parent
    var initId=null;
    document.querySelectorAll('[id^="upd-"]').forEach(function(el){if(el.contains($('utpw-'+uid)))initId=el.id.replace('upd-','')});
    if(initId)loadUpdates(initId);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).addParticipantToUpdate(uid,name);
}
function removeUtPart(uid,name){
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
    var initId=null;
    document.querySelectorAll('[id^="upd-"]').forEach(function(el){if(el.contains($('utpw-'+uid)))initId=el.id.replace('upd-','')});
    if(initId)loadUpdates(initId);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).removeParticipantFromUpdate(uid,name);
}
// Participant management for new update row
function addNewUtPart(initId,name){
  if(!newRowParts[initId])newRowParts[initId]=[];
  if(newRowParts[initId].indexOf(name)>-1)return;
  newRowParts[initId].push(name);
  renderNewRowParts(initId);
  toggleUtPartDrop('new-'+initId);
}
function removeNewUtPart(initId,name){
  if(!newRowParts[initId])return;
  newRowParts[initId]=newRowParts[initId].filter(function(n){return n!==name});
  renderNewRowParts(initId);
}
function renderNewRowParts(initId){
  var el=$('utpc-new-'+initId);if(!el)return;
  var h='';
  (newRowParts[initId]||[]).forEach(function(n){h+='<span class="ut-part-chip">'+esc(n)+' <span class="utpc-x" onclick="removeNewUtPart(\''+initId+'\',\''+n.replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\')">\u00d7</span></span>'});
  h+='<button class="ut-part-add" onclick="toggleUtPartDrop(\'new-'+initId+'\')">+ Add</button>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
  $('ucPart-'+initId).value=(newRowParts[initId]||[]).join(', ');
}
// Close participant dropdowns on outside click
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ut-part-drop.open').forEach(function(d){
    if(!d.parentElement.contains(e.target))d.classList.remove('open');
  });
});

/* ── TRACKER MODALS ── */
function showAddModal(){$('tModalTitle').textContent='Add Initiative';$('dupWarningArea').innerHTML='';$('tId').value='';$('tName').value='';$('tType').value='Tool';$('tStatus').value='Not Started';$('tPriority').value='Medium';$('tStart').value='';$('tEnd').value='';setSelectedEmployees([]);$('tDesc').value='';$('tNotes').value='';$('tLinks').value='';$('tModal').classList.add('show')}
function editTByIdx(idx){var it=trackerItems[idx];if(!it)return;editT(it)}
function editT(it){$('tModalTitle').textContent='Edit Initiative';$('dupWarningArea').innerHTML='';$('tId').value=it.id;$('tName').value=it.taskName||'';$('tType').value=it.type||'Other';$('tStatus').value=it.status||'Not Started';$('tPriority').value=it.priority||'Medium';$('tStart').value=it.startDate||'';$('tEnd').value=it.anticipatedEndDate||'';setSelectedEmployees(it.participants?it.participants.split(', ').filter(Boolean):[]);$('tDesc').value=it.description||'';$('tNotes').value=it.notes||'';$('tLinks').value=it.links||'';$('tModal').classList.add('show')}
function closeTModal(){$('tModal').classList.remove('show')}
var pendingSave=null;
function saveTracker(){
  var it={id:$('tId').value,taskName:$('tName').value.trim(),type:$('tType').value,status:$('tStatus').value,priority:$('tPriority').value,startDate:$('tStart').value,anticipatedEndDate:$('tEnd').value,participants:$('tPart').value,department:'',description:$('tDesc').value.trim(),notes:$('tNotes').value.trim(),links:$('tLinks').value.trim()};
  if(!it.taskName){showAlert({title:'Name Required',msg:'Please enter a name for this initiative.'});return;}
  pendingSave=it;
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(m){if(m&&m.length>0)showDupModal(m);else doSaveTracker(it)}).withFailureHandler(function(){doSaveTracker(it)}).checkDuplicateInitiative(it.taskName,it.description,it.id||'');
}
function doSaveTracker(it){
  closeTModal();closeDupModal();
  var prevId=dpCurrentId,prevArch=dpIsArchive;
  var panelOpen=prevId===it.id&&$('detailsPanel').classList.contains('open');
  if(it.id){
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(items){
        trackerItems=items;applyFilters();
        if(panelOpen)openDetailsPanel(prevId,prevArch);
      }).getTrackerItems();
    }).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Save Failed',msg:e.message})}).updateTrackerItem(it);
  }else{
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(loadTracker).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Save Failed',msg:e.message})}).addTrackerItem(it,U.email);
  }
}
function delT(id){
  var it=trackerItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id});
  $('delArchId').value=id;$('delArchName').textContent=it?it.taskName:'this initiative';
  // Temporarily rebind the exec function for active tracker
  $('delArchModal').dataset.mode='tracker';
  $('delArchModal').classList.add('show');
}
function execArchiveDelete(){
  var id=$('delArchId').value,mode=$('delArchModal').dataset.mode||'archive';
  closeDelArchModal();
  if(mode==='tracker'){
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){loadTracker()}).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Delete Failed',msg:e.message})}).deleteTrackerItem(id);
    $('delArchModal').dataset.mode='archive';
  }else{
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){if(r&&r.success){showAlert({title:'Deleted',msg:'The archived initiative has been removed.',iconBg:'rgba(107,143,113,0.12)',iconColor:'var(--green)',icon:'<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>'});loadArchive()}else{showAlert({title:'Error',msg:(r&&r.error)||'Delete failed'})}}).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Delete Failed',msg:e.message})}).deleteArchivedItem(id);
  }
}
function showDupModal(m){var h='';m.forEach(function(d){h+='<div class="dup-item"><div class="dup-name">'+esc(d.taskName)+'</div>'+(d.description?'<div class="dup-desc">'+esc(d.description)+'</div>':'')+'</div>'});$('dupList').innerHTML=h;$('dupModal').classList.add('show')}
function closeDupModal(){$('dupModal').classList.remove('show')}
function proceedAnywayDup(){if(pendingSave)doSaveTracker(pendingSave);pendingSave=null}

/* ── COMPLETE MODAL ── */
function showCompleteModal(idx){
  var it=trackerItems[idx];if(!it)return;
  $('compId').value=it.id;$('compName').textContent=it.taskName;
  $('compSop').value='';$('compDesc').value='';$('compLinks').value='';
  // Show Tech Stack section for "Tool" type initiatives
  var tsSection=$('techStackSection');
  var isTool=(it.type||'').toLowerCase()==='tool';
  if(isTool){
    tsSection.style.display='block';
    $('tsUrl').value=it.links||'';$('tsUsername').value='';$('tsPassword').value='';
    $('tsTags').value='';$('tsNotes').value='';$('tsSkip').checked=false;
    // Populate owner dropdown
    var ownerSel=$('tsOwner');ownerSel.innerHTML='<option value="">Select person...</option>';
    TEAM_LIST.forEach(function(t){var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=t.name;o.textContent=t.name;ownerSel.appendChild(o)});
  }else{tsSection.style.display='none'}
  // Document Registry section — always visible
  $('drDocType').value='SOP';$('drDept').value='';$('drPurpose').value='';$('drContext').value='';
  $('drOwner').value='';$('drSummary').value='';$('drFileLink').value='';$('drTags').value='';
  $('drEmpSearch').value='';
  updateDrTitlePreview();
  initDrEmployeeList();
  // Live title preview listeners
  ['drDocType','drDept','drPurpose','drContext'].forEach(function(fid){
    $(fid).oninput=updateDrTitlePreview;$(fid).onchange=updateDrTitlePreview;
  });
  // Auto-copy SOP link to Document Registry file link field
  $('compSop').oninput=function(){$('drFileLink').value=$('compSop').value};
  // Store Tool flag on the modal element so submitComplete can read it reliably
  $('compModal').dataset.isTool=isTool?'1':'0';
  $('compModal').classList.add('show');
}
function closeCompModal(){$('compModal').classList.remove('show')}
function submitComplete(){
  var sop=$('compSop').value.trim(),desc=$('compDesc').value.trim(),links=$('compLinks').value.trim();
  if(!sop){showAlert({title:'SOP Required',msg:'Please provide a SOP / Documentation link.'});$('compSop').focus();return}
  if(!desc){showAlert({title:'Summary Required',msg:'Please provide a completion summary.'});$('compDesc').focus();return}
  var compId=$('compId').value;
  var compName=$('compName').textContent;
  // Check if this is a Tool using the stored flag (not display style which can be unreliable)
  var addToTS=$('compModal').dataset.isTool==='1'&&!$('tsSkip').checked;
  // Capture all Tech Stack values BEFORE closing modal
  var tsData=null;
  if(addToTS){
    tsData={
      toolName:compName,
      toolType:$('tsToolType').value,
      accessUrl:$('tsUrl').value.trim(),
      username:$('tsUsername').value.trim(),
      password:$('tsPassword').value.trim(),
      responsiblePerson:$('tsOwner').value,
      description:desc,
      tags:$('tsTags').value.trim(),
      department:$('tsDept').value,
      notes:$('tsNotes').value.trim(),
      clientOwner:$('tsToolType').value==='Client'?'':'Single Throw'
    };
  }
  // Capture Document Registry values BEFORE closing modal
  var addToDR=true; // Document Registry is mandatory
  var drData=null;
  if(addToDR){
    var drDocType=$('drDocType').value,drDept=$('drDept').value,drPurpose=$('drPurpose').value.trim(),drContext=$('drContext').value.trim();
    var drOwner=$('drOwner').value,drSummary=$('drSummary').value.trim(),drFileLink=$('drFileLink').value.trim()||sop;
    var drTags=$('drTags').value.trim();
    // Validate required fields
    if(!drDocType){showAlert({title:'Document Type Required',msg:'Please select a document type.'});$('drDocType').focus();return}
    if(!drDept){showAlert({title:'Department Required',msg:'Please select a department.'});$('drDept').focus();return}
    if(!drPurpose){showAlert({title:'Purpose Required',msg:'Please fill in the document purpose.'});$('drPurpose').focus();return}
    if(!drContext){showAlert({title:'Context Required',msg:'Please fill in the document context.'});$('drContext').focus();return}
    if(!drOwner){showAlert({title:'Owner Role Required',msg:'Please fill in the owner role.'});$('drOwner').focus();return}
    if(!drSummary){showAlert({title:'Summary Required',msg:'Please fill in the document summary.'});$('drSummary').focus();return}
    var drEmails=[];
    document.querySelectorAll('.dr-emp-cb:checked').forEach(function(cb){drEmails.push(cb.value)});
    if(drEmails.length===0){showAlert({title:'Viewers Required',msg:'Select at least one person who can view this document.'});return}
    drData={
      documentType:drDocType,department:drDept,purpose:drPurpose,context:drContext,
      owner:drOwner,summary:drSummary,fileLink:drFileLink,tags:drTags,
      visibleToEmails:drEmails
    };
  }
  closeCompModal();
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
    loadTracker();loadArchive();
    if(tsData){
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
        if(r&&r.success)showAlert({title:'Added to Tech Stack',msg:'Saved to Tech Stack Hub ('+r.tab+').',iconBg:'rgba(107,143,113,0.12)',iconColor:'var(--green)',icon:'<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>'});
        else if(r&&r.error)showAlert({title:'Tech Stack Error',msg:r.error});
      }).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Tech Stack Sync Failed',msg:e.message})}).addToTechStack(tsData);
    }
    if(drData){
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
        if(r&&r.success)showAlert({title:'Submitted to Document Registry',msg:'Logged as '+r.internalID+' — pending approval.',iconBg:'rgba(107,143,113,0.12)',iconColor:'var(--green)',icon:'<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>'});
        else if(r&&r.error)showAlert({title:'Document Registry Error',msg:r.error});
      }).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Document Registry Sync Failed',msg:e.message})}).submitToDocRegistry(drData);
    }
  }).withFailureHandler(err).completeTrackerItem({id:compId,sopLink:sop,completionDesc:desc,completionLinks:links},U.email);
}

function initDrEmployeeList(){
  var el=$('drEmployeeList');if(!el||!TEAM_LIST)return;

    return '<label class="dr-emp-row" data-name="'+t.name.toLowerCase()+'" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 4px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0">'
      +'<input type="checkbox" class="dr-emp-cb" value="'+t.email+'" style="flex-shrink:0;width:14px;height:14px" onchange="updateDrCount()"><span style="overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">'+esc(t.name)+'</span></label>';
  }).join('');
  updateDrCount();
}
function filterDrEmployees(){

}
