/* ── UTILS ── */
function getInitials(name){if(!name)return'ST';var parts=name.trim().split(/\s+/);if(parts.length>=2)return(parts[0][0]+parts[parts.length-1][0]).toUpperCase();return name.substring(0,2).toUpperCase()}
function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function esc(s){if(!s)return'';var d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=s;return d.innerHTML}
function eA(s){return(s||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'\\"').replace(/\n/g,'\\n')}
function fD(d){if(!d)return'—';try{if(d instanceof Date||(typeof d==='string'&&d.length>0)){var dt=new Date(d);if(!isNaN(dt.getTime()))return dt.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'})}return String(d)}catch(e){return String(d)||'—'}}
function err(e){console.error(e)}

/* ── EMPLOYEE MULTI-SELECT (from real directory) ── */
var selectedEmployees=[];
function initPartDropdown(){
  var drop=$('tPartDrop'),h='<div style="padding:.4rem;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--bg-w);z-index:1"><input type="text" id="partSearch" placeholder="Search names..." oninput="filterPartDropdown(this.value)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()" style="width:100%;background:var(--bg);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.4rem .6rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text)"></div>';
  TEAM_LIST.forEach(function(t){h+='<div class="multi-select-option" data-name="'+t.name+'" onclick="toggleEmployee(\''+t.name.replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\',this)"><div class="check-box"></div>'+t.name+'</div>'});
  drop.innerHTML=h;
}
function filterPartDropdown(query){
  var q=query.toLowerCase(),opts=$('tPartDrop').querySelectorAll('.multi-select-option');
  opts.forEach(function(o){o.style.display=o.dataset.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1?'':'none'});
}
function togglePartDropdown(){
  var sel=$('tPartSelected'),drop=$('tPartDrop');var o=drop.classList.contains('open');
  if(o){drop.classList.remove('open');sel.classList.remove('open')}
  else{drop.classList.add('open');sel.classList.add('open');var si=$('partSearch');if(si){si.value='';filterPartDropdown('');si.focus()}}
}
function toggleEmployee(name,el){var idx=selectedEmployees.indexOf(name);if(idx>-1){selectedEmployees.splice(idx,1);el.classList.remove('checked')}else{selectedEmployees.push(name);el.classList.add('checked')}updatePartDisplay()}
function updatePartDisplay(){var sel=$('tPartSelected');if(!selectedEmployees.length){sel.innerHTML='<span class="multi-select-placeholder">Select team members...</span>'}else{var h='';selectedEmployees.forEach(function(n){h+='<span class="multi-select-chip">'+n+' <span class="chip-x" onclick="event.stopPropagation();removeEmployee(\''+n.replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\')">×</span></span>'});sel.innerHTML=h}$('tPart').value=selectedEmployees.join(', ')}
function removeEmployee(name){selectedEmployees=selectedEmployees.filter(function(n){return n!==name});var opts=$('tPartDrop').querySelectorAll('.multi-select-option');opts.forEach(function(o){if(o.dataset.name===name)o.classList.remove('checked')});updatePartDisplay()}
function setSelectedEmployees(arr){selectedEmployees=arr.slice();var opts=$('tPartDrop').querySelectorAll('.multi-select-option');opts.forEach(function(o){if(selectedEmployees.indexOf(o.dataset.name)>-1)o.classList.add('checked');else o.classList.remove('checked')});updatePartDisplay()}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var wrap=$('tPartWrap');if(wrap&&!wrap.contains(e.target)){$('tPartDrop').classList.remove('open');$('tPartSelected').classList.remove('open')}
});



/* ═══════════ @MENTION AUTOCOMPLETE ═══════════ */
// ── BRANDED CONFIRM / ALERT ──
var _confirmCb=null;
function showConfirm(opts){
  $('confirmTitle').textContent=opts.title||'Are you sure?';
  $('confirmMsg').textContent=opts.msg||'';
  var icon=$('confirmIcon');
  icon.innerHTML=opts.icon||'<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>';
  icon.style.background=opts.iconBg||'rgba(185,74,72,0.12)';
  icon.style.color=opts.iconColor||'var(--danger)';
  var cls=opts.confirmClass||'btn-danger-o';
  $('confirmFoot').innerHTML='<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="closeConfirm()">'+(opts.cancelLabel||'Cancel')+'</button><button class="btn '+cls+'" onclick="doConfirm()">'+(opts.confirmLabel||'Confirm')+'</button>';
  _confirmCb=opts.onConfirm||null;
  $('confirmModal').classList.add('show');
}
function showAlert(opts){
  $('confirmTitle').textContent=opts.title||'';
  $('confirmMsg').textContent=opts.msg||'';
  var icon=$('confirmIcon');
  icon.innerHTML=opts.icon||'<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v4M12 16h.01"/></svg>';
  icon.style.background=opts.iconBg||'rgba(26,82,118,0.1)';
  icon.style.color=opts.iconColor||'var(--blue-l)';
  $('confirmFoot').innerHTML='<button class="btn btn-grad" onclick="closeConfirm()">'+(opts.label||'OK')+'</button>';
  _confirmCb=null;
  $('confirmModal').classList.add('show');
}
function closeConfirm(){$('confirmModal').classList.remove('show');_confirmCb=null;}
function doConfirm(){var cb=_confirmCb;closeConfirm();if(cb)cb();}

var acDropdown=null,acTarget=null,acItems=[],acIdx=-1,acStart=-1;

function initMentionAC(){
  // Create the single shared dropdown
  acDropdown=document.createElement('div');
  acDropdown.className='mention-ac';
  acDropdown.id='mentionAC';
  document.body.appendChild(acDropdown);

  // Attach to all textareas and inputs that support mentions
  document.addEventListener('input',function(e){
    var el=e.target;
    if(el.tagName==='TEXTAREA'||(el.tagName==='INPUT'&&el.type==='text')){
      // Only activate on fields that are meant for mentions (community, comments, updates)
      var isMentionField=el.id==='cContent'||el.id.indexOf('ci-')===0||el.id.indexOf('uci-')===0||el.id.indexOf('ucDesc-')===0||el.id.indexOf('dpUcDesc-')===0||el.id==='euDesc'||el.id==='enNotes';
      if(!isMentionField)return;
      handleMentionInput(el);
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(!acDropdown.classList.contains('open'))return;
    if(e.key==='ArrowDown'){e.preventDefault();acIdx=Math.min(acIdx+1,acItems.length-1);highlightAC()}
    else if(e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();acIdx=Math.max(acIdx-1,0);highlightAC()}
    else if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key==='Tab'){if(acIdx>=0&&acIdx<acItems.length){e.preventDefault();selectAC(acItems[acIdx])}}
    else if(e.key==='Escape'){closeAC()}
  });

  // Close when clicking outside
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(acDropdown&&!acDropdown.contains(e.target))closeAC();
  });
}

function handleMentionInput(el){
  var val=el.value,pos=el.selectionStart;
  // Find the @ symbol before cursor
  var textBefore=val.substring(0,pos);
  var atIdx=textBefore.lastIndexOf('@');
  if(atIdx===-1||atIdx<pos-30){closeAC();return}
  // Make sure the @ is at start or preceded by whitespace
  if(atIdx>0&&!/\s/.test(textBefore[atIdx-1])){closeAC();return}
  var query=textBefore.substring(atIdx+1).toLowerCase();
  if(query.length===0){
    // Just typed @, show everyone option + full list
    showACSuggestions(el,atIdx,query,true);
    return;
  }
  showACSuggestions(el,atIdx,query,false);
}

function showACSuggestions(el,atIndex,query,showAll){
  acTarget=el;acStart=atIndex;
  var matches=[];
  // Always include @everyone if it matches
  if(showAll||'everyone'.indexOf(query)===0){
    matches.push({name:'everyone',type:'everyone'});
  }
  // Filter team members
  TEAM_LIST.forEach(function(t){
    var nameLower=t.name.toLowerCase();
    var parts=nameLower.split(' ');
    if(showAll||nameLower.indexOf(query)===0||parts[0].indexOf(query)===0||(parts[1]&&parts[1].indexOf(query)===0)){
      matches.push({name:t.name,email:t.email,type:'person'});
    }
  });
  if(!matches.length){closeAC();return}
  acItems=matches;acIdx=0;
  // Build dropdown HTML
  var h='';matches.forEach(function(m,i){
    if(m.type==='everyone'){
      h+='<div class="mention-ac-item'+(i===0?' active':'')+'" data-idx="'+i+'" onmousedown="event.preventDefault();selectAC(acItems['+i+'])" onmouseenter="acIdx='+i+';highlightAC()">'
        +'<div class="ac-everyone"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg></div>'
        +'<span class="ac-name">@everyone</span></div>';
    }else{
      var ini=getInitials(m.name);
      h+='<div class="mention-ac-item'+(i===0?' active':'')+'" data-idx="'+i+'" onmousedown="event.preventDefault();selectAC(acItems['+i+'])" onmouseenter="acIdx='+i+';highlightAC()">'
        +'<div class="ac-avatar">'+ini+'</div>'
        +'<span class="ac-name">'+esc(m.name)+'</span></div>';
    }
  });
  acDropdown.innerHTML=h;
  // Position dropdown near the textarea
  positionAC(el);
  acDropdown.classList.add('open');
}

function positionAC(el){
  var rect=el.getBoundingClientRect();
  // Place below the textarea, aligned to left
  acDropdown.style.position='fixed';
  acDropdown.style.left=rect.left+'px';
  acDropdown.style.top=(rect.bottom+4)+'px';
  acDropdown.style.width=Math.min(rect.width,280)+'px';
  // If it would go off screen bottom, place above
  var dropH=acDropdown.offsetHeight||200;
  if(rect.bottom+4+dropH>window.innerHeight){
    acDropdown.style.top=(rect.top-dropH-4)+'px';
  }
}

function highlightAC(){
  var items=acDropdown.querySelectorAll('.mention-ac-item');
  items.forEach(function(el,i){if(i===acIdx)el.classList.add('active');else el.classList.remove('active')});
  // Scroll into view
  if(items[acIdx])items[acIdx].scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
}

function selectAC(item){
  if(!acTarget)return;
  var val=acTarget.value;
  var pos=acTarget.selectionStart;
  var before=val.substring(0,acStart);
  var after=val.substring(pos);
  var insertName=item.name;
  var newVal=before+'@'+insertName+' '+after;
  acTarget.value=newVal;
  // Set cursor after the inserted name
  var newPos=acStart+1+insertName.length+1;
  acTarget.selectionStart=acTarget.selectionEnd=newPos;
  acTarget.focus();
  closeAC();
}

function closeAC(){
  if(acDropdown)acDropdown.classList.remove('open');
  acIdx=-1;acItems=[];
}


/* ── INITIATIVE NOTES STREAM ── */
function submitDpNote(initId){
  var ta=$('dpNoteInput-'+initId);
  if(!ta)return;
  var content=ta.value.trim();
  if(!content){showAlert({title:'Note Required',msg:'Please write a note before saving.'});return;}
  ta.value='';ta.style.height='';
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(n){
    if(n&&n.id){
      // Add note to dpCurrentNotes and re-render the notes block only
      dpCurrentNotes.push(n);
      renderDpNotesBlock(initId);
    }
  }).withFailureHandler(err).addInitiativeNote(initId,content);
}

function deleteDpNote(noteId,initId){
  showConfirm({title:'Delete Note',msg:'This note will be permanently removed.',confirmLabel:'Delete',onConfirm:function(){
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
      if(r&&r.success){
        dpCurrentNotes=dpCurrentNotes.filter(function(n){return n.id!==noteId});
        renderDpNotesBlock(initId);
      }
    }).withFailureHandler(err).deleteInitiativeNote(noteId);
  }});
}

function renderDpNotesBlock(initId){
  var container=$('dp-notes-block-'+initId);
  if(!container)return;
  var isArchive=dpIsArchive;
  var h='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.75rem"><div class="dp-notes-label"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6"/></svg> Notes</div></div>';
  if(dpCurrentNotes&&dpCurrentNotes.length){
    dpCurrentNotes.forEach(function(n){
      h+='<div class="dp-note-entry" id="dpne-'+n.id+'">';
      h+='<div class="dp-note-content" id="dpnc-'+n.id+'">'+esc(n.content)+'</div>';
      h+='<div class="dp-note-meta"><span class="dp-note-author">'+esc(n.userName)+'</span><span class="dp-note-date">'+fD(n.createdAt)+'</span>';
      if(!isArchive){
        h+='<div class="dp-note-actions">';
        h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs dp-note-edit" onclick="editDpNote(\''+n.id+'\',\''+initId+'\')">'+svgEdit+'</button>';
        h+='<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-xs dp-note-del" onclick="deleteDpNote(\''+n.id+'\',\''+initId+'\')">'+svgTrash+'</button>';
        h+='</div>';
      }
      h+='</div></div>';
    });
  } else {
    h+='<div class="dp-note-empty">No notes yet. Add the first one below.</div>';
  }
  if(!isArchive){
    h+='<div class="dp-note-add-row">';
    h+='<textarea id="dpNoteInput-'+initId+'" class="dp-note-textarea" placeholder="Add a note..." rows="2" oninput="autoGrow(this)"></textarea>';
    h+='<button class="btn btn-grad btn-sm" onclick="submitDpNote(\''+initId+'\')"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg> Add Note</button>';
    h+='</div>';
  }
  container.innerHTML=h;
}

/* ── APPROVE (before Complete) ── */
function showApproveModal(idx){
  var it=trackerItems[idx];if(!it)return;
  $('approveId').value=it.id;
  $('approveName').textContent=it.taskName;
  if($('approveSummary'))$('approveSummary').value='';
  if($('approveSopLink'))$('approveSopLink').value=it.links?it.links.split(',').map(function(l){var p=l.trim();return p.indexOf('|')>-1?p.split('|').slice(1).join('|').trim():p}).filter(function(l){return/^https?:\/\//i.test(l)})[0]||'':'';
  if($('approveToolLink'))$('approveToolLink').value='';
  $('approveModal').classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(function(){if($('approveSummary'))$('approveSummary').focus();},100);
}
function closeApproveModal(){$('approveModal').classList.remove('show')}
function dpApproveById(id){
  var list=dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems;
  var idx=list.findIndex(function(i){return i.id===id});
  if(idx>-1)showApproveModal(idx);
}
function submitApprovalRequest(){
  var id=$('approveId').value;
  var summary=($('approveSummary')||{}).value||'';
  var sopLink=($('approveSopLink')||{}).value||'';
  var toolLink=($('approveToolLink')||{}).value||'';
  if(!summary.trim()){showAlert({title:'Summary Required',msg:'Please provide a final summary before sending.'});return;}
  if(!sopLink.trim()){showAlert({title:'SOP Link Required',msg:'Please provide the SOP / documentation link.'});return;}
  closeApproveModal();
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
    if(r&&r.success){
      // Update local item so button grays out immediately
      var it=trackerItems.find(function(i){return i.id===id});
      if(it)it.approvalStatus='pending';
      loadTracker();
      if(dpCurrentId===id)openDetailsPanel(id,false);
      showAlert({
        title:'Approval Request Sent',
        msg:'The approval team has been notified. Once approved, you can proceed to mark it complete.',
        iconBg:'rgba(107,143,113,0.12)',iconColor:'var(--green)',
        icon:'<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>'
      });
    } else {
      showAlert({title:'Error',msg:(r&&r.error)||'Could not send approval email.'});
    }
  }).withFailureHandler(function(e){showAlert({title:'Error',msg:e.message})}).sendApprovalEmail(id,summary.trim(),sopLink.trim(),toolLink.trim());
}


/* ── NOTE EDIT (inline) ── */
function editDpNote(noteId, initId){
  var contentEl=$('dpnc-'+noteId);
  if(!contentEl)return;
  var current=contentEl.textContent||'';
  contentEl.dataset.original=current;
  contentEl.dataset.initId=initId;
  contentEl.innerHTML='<textarea class="dp-note-edit-area" id="dpneta-'+noteId+'" rows="3"></textarea>'
    +'<div style="display:flex;gap:.4rem;margin-top:.3rem">'
    +'<button class="btn btn-grad btn-xs" onclick="submitNoteEdit(\''+noteId+'\')">Save</button>'
    +'<button class="btn btn-outline btn-xs" onclick="cancelNoteEdit(\''+noteId+'\')">Cancel</button>'
    +'</div>';
  var ta=$('dpneta-'+noteId);
  if(ta){ta.value=current;ta.style.height='auto';ta.style.height=ta.scrollHeight+'px';ta.focus();ta.setSelectionRange(ta.value.length,ta.value.length);}
}
function cancelNoteEdit(noteId){
  var contentEl=$('dpnc-'+noteId);
  if(!contentEl)return;
  var original=contentEl.dataset.original||'';
  contentEl.innerHTML=esc(original);
}
function submitNoteEdit(noteId){
  var contentEl=$('dpnc-'+noteId);
  var ta=$('dpneta-'+noteId);
  if(!ta||!contentEl)return;
  var newContent=ta.value.trim();
  if(!newContent){showAlert({title:'Required',msg:'Note cannot be empty.'});return;}
  var initId=contentEl.dataset.initId||'';
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
    if(r&&r.success){
      contentEl.innerHTML=esc(newContent);
      dpCurrentNotes.forEach(function(n){if(n.id===noteId)n.content=newContent;});
    } else {
      showAlert({title:'Error',msg:'Could not save note.'});
    }
  }).withFailureHandler(err).updateInitiativeNote(noteId,newContent);
}

/* ── LINK ENTRY PARSER (Title|URL format) ── */
function parseLinkEntry(entry){
  entry=(entry||'').trim();
  var pipeIdx=entry.indexOf('|');
  if(pipeIdx>-1){
    var t=entry.substring(0,pipeIdx).trim();
    var u=entry.substring(pipeIdx+1).trim();
    return{title:t,url:u,display:u.replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?/,'').substring(0,45)};
  }
  return{title:'',url:entry,display:entry.replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?/,'').substring(0,45)};
}

/* ── LINK MANAGEMENT ── */
function addDpLink(initId){
  var inp=$('dpLinkInput-'+initId);
  var titleInp=$('dpLinkTitle-'+initId);
  if(!inp)return;
  var url=inp.value.trim();
  var title=titleInp?titleInp.value.trim():'';
  if(!url){showAlert({title:'URL Required',msg:'Please paste a URL before adding.'});return;}
  if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)){url='https://'+url;}
  var entry=title?title+'|'+url:url;
  var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===initId});
  if(!it)return;
  var links=it.links?it.links.split(',').map(function(l){return l.trim()}).filter(Boolean):[];
  links.push(entry);
  var newLinks=links.join(', ');
  inp.value='';if(titleInp)titleInp.value='';
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
    it.links=newLinks;
    renderDpLinksBlock(initId,it);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).quickUpdateField(initId,'links',newLinks);
}
function editDpLink(initId, linkIdx, currentEntry){
  // currentEntry is either "Title|URL" or plain "URL"
  var parts=currentEntry.indexOf('|')>-1?currentEntry.split('|'):[''  ,currentEntry];
  var currentTitle=parts[0]||'';
  var currentUrl=parts.slice(1).join('|')||currentEntry;
  // Use the edit-link modal
  $('editLinkInitId').value=initId;
  $('editLinkIdx').value=linkIdx;
  $('editLinkTitle').value=currentTitle;
  $('editLinkUrl').value=currentUrl;
  $('editLinkModal').classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(function(){$('editLinkTitle').focus();},100);
}
function closeEditLinkModal(){$('editLinkModal').classList.remove('show')}
function submitEditLink(){
  var initId=$('editLinkInitId').value;
  var linkIdx=parseInt($('editLinkIdx').value);
  var newTitle=$('editLinkTitle').value.trim();
  var newUrl=$('editLinkUrl').value.trim();
  if(!newUrl){showAlert({title:'URL Required',msg:'Please enter a URL.'});return;}
  if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(newUrl))newUrl='https://'+newUrl;
  var entry=newTitle?newTitle+'|'+newUrl:newUrl;
  closeEditLinkModal();
  var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===initId});
  if(!it)return;
  var links=it.links?it.links.split(',').map(function(l){return l.trim()}).filter(Boolean):[];
  links[linkIdx]=entry;
  var newLinks=links.join(', ');
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
    it.links=newLinks;
    renderDpLinksBlock(initId,it);
  }).withFailureHandler(err).quickUpdateField(initId,'links',newLinks);
}
function deleteDpLink(initId, linkIdx){
  showConfirm({title:'Remove Link',msg:'Remove this link from the initiative?',confirmLabel:'Remove',onConfirm:function(){
    var it=(dpIsArchive?archiveItems:trackerItems).find(function(i){return i.id===initId});
    if(!it)return;
    var links=it.links?it.links.split(',').map(function(l){return l.trim()}).filter(Boolean):[];
    links.splice(linkIdx,1);
    var newLinks=links.join(', ');
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(){
      it.links=newLinks;
      renderDpLinksBlock(initId,it);
    }).withFailureHandler(err).quickUpdateField(initId,'links',newLinks);
  }});
}
function renderDpLinksBlock(initId, it){
  var container=$('dp-links-block-'+initId);
  if(!container)return;
  var isArchive=dpIsArchive;
  var h='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.6rem">';
  h+='<div class="dp-notes-label"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"/><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"/></svg> Links</div></div>';
  if(it.links){
    var la=it.links.split(',').map(function(l){return l.trim()}).filter(Boolean);
    if(la.length){
      la.forEach(function(l,li){
        var parsed=parseLinkEntry(l);
        h+='<div class="dp-link-row">';
        if(parsed.title)h+='<span class="dp-link-title">'+esc(parsed.title)+'</span>';
        h+='<a href="'+esc(parsed.url)+'" target="_blank" class="link-chip" style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">'+svgLink+' '+esc(parsed.display)+'</a>';
        if(!isArchive){
          h+='<div style="display:flex;gap:.25rem;flex-shrink:0">';
          h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-xs" onclick="editDpLink(\''+initId+'\','+li+',\''+eA(l)+'\')">'+svgEdit+'</button>';
          h+='<button class="btn btn-danger-o btn-xs" onclick="deleteDpLink(\''+initId+'\','+li+')">'+svgTrash+'</button>';
          h+='</div>';
        }
        h+='</div>';
      });
    } else { h+='<div class="dp-note-empty">No links added.</div>'; }
  } else { h+='<div class="dp-note-empty">No links added.</div>'; }
  if(!isArchive){
    h+='<div class="dp-link-add-row" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr auto;gap:.5rem;margin-top:.6rem;align-items:center">';
    h+='<input id="dpLinkTitle-'+initId+'" placeholder="Title (e.g. SOP Doc)" style="background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .75rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text)">';
    h+='<input id="dpLinkInput-'+initId+'" placeholder="Paste a URL..." style="background:var(--bg-w);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:.45rem .75rem;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text)" onkeypress="if(event.key===\'Enter\')addDpLink(\''+initId+'\')">';
    h+='<button class="btn btn-soft btn-sm" onclick="addDpLink(\''+initId+'\')"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg> Add</button>';
    h+='</div>';
  }
  container.innerHTML=h;
}

// Initialize on load
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){initMentionAC()});
</script>
</body>
</html>
